text:
priya: Quick sync — need to lock the PRD acceptance criteria for Console telemetry (trace sampling + retention tiers + per-route dashboard UX). We have customer asks and a few tradeoffs to resolve.

matt: +1. can we enumerate non-negotiables vs stretch? cc @elaine for UX impact.

elaine: UX note — per-route dashboard should default to auto-aggregated view, with a single-click drilldown to traces. We should avoid >3 clicks for core flows.

priya: Agree. Draft AC sketched below — want comments specifically on retention tier names, default sampling, and rollout gating.

priya: ```
Acceptance criteria v0.3:
1) Traces: per-route sampling config exposed in console with defaults: 1% global, 5% high-traffic routes.
2) Retention tiers: 7d (free), 30d (standard), 90d (enterprise) — UI + billing labels exist.
3) Dashboards: create per-route dashboard template with latency, error-rate, qps, 95/99 p50 lines. Drill-to-trace opens trace viewer filtered by route and time window.
4) Rollout: feature flagged, 10% canary -> 50% -> 100% over staged days with automatic rollback on >2x error rate.
5) Privacy: PII redaction pipeline runs on ingest; console shows redaction status.
6) Backcompat: existing queries unchanged; legacy saved dashboards map to new per-route pages.
```

chen: Backend questions: where do sampling configs live? propose API: `POST /v1/telemetry/sampling` and a read endpoint. Will need migration for existing sampling overrides.

matt: Costs: 90d retention for enterprise customers will raise storage by ~3x for traces. Need clear unit-cost line items and a preview in billing UI. Also: suggest making 90d opt-in per-customer until we have compaction/rollup.

elaine: UX edgecases: what if a route is renamed? Should map historical traces by route-id not route-name. Need warning in UI when renaming.

priya: Good catch. We'll require route-id association in the PRD and an import/mapping tool for renamed routes.

sasha: Customer ask from Acme: they need 90d retention and retention export to S3 for compliance. Can we include export as an enterprise add-on in scope?

priya: Export is desirable but maybe stretch. Proposed approach: MVP — allow manual export of selected time ranges -> S3. Full continuous replication as follow-on. Thoughts?

matt: Manual export sounds OK for MVP. Add acceptance test: export zipped traces for given time window, S3 PUT success, and UI shows job status.

elaine: Onboarding flows: add a short modal that explains retention tiers and cost impact when enabling >30d. Must show estimated monthly cost delta.

chen: Implementation note: KV cache and batch pipeline will need a retention compaction step to reduce older trace granularity for 90d tier — otherwise cost is prohibitive. Raise with infra.

ops-bot: infra-runbook: https://runbook.internal/telemetry-retention — contains current compaction experiment notes.

priya: Ok action items: 1) matt: draft cost preview calc + numbers for PRD by EOD Wed; 2) chen: sketch API + migration plan; 3) elaine: wireframes for per-route dashboard + rename warning modal; 4) sasha: confirm Acme compliance needs and priority. I'll update PRD and add gating checklist for canary.

matt: acked.

elaine: will mock by Thurs.

chen: I'll post API proto and migration script outline tomorrow.

sasha: I'll coordinate with Acme and get back by Friday.

priya: Thanks — plan to cut PRD update and request approvals on Monday. If anyone sees a hard blocker (PII ingestion, billing mismatch, or infra limits) call it out here. :thumbsup:
